status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 60% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 60 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Israeli forces are expanding operations in southern Syria, threatening new territory in Syria, Lebanon and Gaza, while Syrian security personnel were killed in a Damascus countryside attack and in a Jaramana raid that also wounded four others. Christian leaders condemned recent attacks on their community, and the UN deputy relief chief warned that Syrians cannot afford more instability. Iraq sentenced six French nationals to life imprisonment for joining ISIL, and France jailed three women for joining ISIS in Syria. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker utvider operasjonene i sørlige Syria, og truer nytt territorium i Syria, Libanon og Gaza, mens syrisk sikkerhetspersonell ble drept i et angrep på landsbygda utenfor Damaskus og i et raid i Jaramana som også såret fire andre. Kristne ledere fordømte nylige angrep på deres samfunn, og FNs nestleder for nødhjelp advarte om at syrerne ikke har råd til mer ustabilitet. Irak dømte seks franske statsborgere til livsvarig fengsel for å ha sluttet seg til IS, og Frankrike fengslet tre kvinner for å ha sluttet seg til IS i Syria. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
